Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 2004
ACT V OF 2004
BALOCHISTAN
EDUCATION FOUNDATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act, to amend
the Balochistan Education Foundation Act, 1994
[Gazette of
Balochistan Extraordinary, 13th May, 2004]
No.PAB/Regis: V(16)/2004,
dated 13-5-2004.--The Balochistan Education Foundation (Amendment) Bill,
2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 7th May,
2004 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the Education Foundation
(Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 2 of Act VII of 1994

2. Amendment of section 2 of
Act VII of 1994.----In the Bal6chistan Education Foundation Act, 1994,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act after clause (h) of section 2, the
following new clause shall be inserted:--
'(ha) "Governor" means
the Governor of Balochistan.

2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 7th May,
2004 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an
Act of the Provincial Assembly.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
4. Amendment of section 5 of
Act VII of 1994.--- In the said Act, in section 5 (a) for subsection (1)
the following shall be substituted:--
"(a) There
shall be a Board of Directors of the Foundation consisting of sixteen members
of which not more than four will be official members as may be appointed by the
Governor through a Gazette notification. The Governor shall also be the
Chairman of the Board".
(b) In
subsections (1), (2), (3), and (4) for the word Government" where-ever
.occurring, the word ,"Governor" shall be substituted.
